enabled.description:
DEV/DEMO ONLY. This issues signed tokens to anyone who asks, with whatever
scopes they request, and authenticates nobody. Never install it in an
environment that matters. The umbrella chart additionally refuses to enable it
unless `demoMode` is set.
enabled.title: enabled

gateway.description:
HTTPRoute exposing the token endpoint through the shared Gateway, so a demo
user can mint a token from outside the cluster.

hostnames.description:
Restrict the route to these hostnames. Empty means "any host", which is what
lets the wizard hand the user a working URL for whatever address the Gateway
ends up with.
hostnames.title: hostnames

pathPrefix.description:
Path prefix the issuer is served under. mock-oauth2-server derives it from
the issuer id baked into the persona config ("labs64io"), so this MUST match
that value — because it does, the route needs no path rewrite.
pathPrefix.title: pathPrefix

gateway.title: gateway

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.
global.title: global

image.description: This sets the container image more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/containers/images/

pullPolicy.description: This sets the pull policy for images.
pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy

tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.
tag.title: tag

image.title: image

networkPolicy.description:
Restrict this pod's traffic. Egress is DNS-only: the server calls nothing,
it signs tokens from the static config mounted at startup.

gatewayNamespace.description:
Namespace the shared Gateway runs in; ingress is accepted from there and
from this release's own namespace.
gatewayNamespace.title: gatewayNamespace

networkPolicy.title: networkPolicy

replicaCount.description: This will set the replicaset count more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/replicaset/
replicaCount.title: replicaCount

resources.description:
Resource requests/limits. The server holds a handful of static personas in
memory and signs short-lived tokens; it needs very little.
resources.title: resources

service.description: This is for setting up a service more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/

port.description: This sets the ports more information can be found here: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/#field-spec-ports
port.title: port

service.title: service
